In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pad-fan system is an effective way to cool a greenhouse and to reduce the energy consumption of the cooling system, but it is not recommended to use it with recently transplanted crops.
the pad-fan system is not the most suitable for use in a Mediterranean greenhouse, as it is very difficult to achieve a homogeneous distribution of air temperature and humidity in the crop area.
, although the crop reduces the airflow, the cooling system is able to provide the air exchange required by the crop.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pad-fan system is an efficient way of reducing greenhouse temperature when the crop is well developed.
a pad-fan system operating with a well-developing tomato crop has a clear effect in stabilizing airflow, reducing turbulence, and reducing the temperature gradient inside the greenhouse.
the presence of the crop in the greenhouse reduces the air velocity and turbulence levels, and reduces the differences in temperature and humidity between the entrance and exit of the greenhouse.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the airflow and climate conditions in a greenhouse equipped with a cooling system are strongly dependent on the crop.
the pad-fan system produces a very unstable climate, which is not desirable for young plants.
growers should be aware that when a pad-fan system is operating, the air velocity and turbulence inside the greenhouse are high.
